<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/management/devices/{id}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



FindOne handles HTTP requests to retrieve a single device by its ID.
It parses the "id" parameter from the request URL, validates it, and calls the deviceService to fetch the device.
If the ID is invalid, it returns a 422 Unprocessable Entity response.
If the device is not found, it returns a 404 Not Found response.
On success, it returns the device data with a 200 OK response.
